critical insight into the planet's mesoscale atmospheric dynamics and their

and temporal patterns that vary over the Martian day. In this study, we

events_Listopad 2024.title:
Astro Paper: From Shock to Synchrotron: a mini-review on magnetic turbulence in
  Supernova Remnants
events_Listopad 2024.summary:
Magnetic turbulence plays a crucial role in confining charged particles near
the shock front of Supernova Remnants, enabling them to reach energies up to
hundreds of TeV through a process known as Diffusive Shock Acceleration (DSA).
These high-energy electrons spiral along magnetic field lines, emitting X-ray
synchrotron radiation. The launch of the Imaging X-ray Polarimetry Explorer
(IXPE) has opened a new window into the study of magnetic fields in SNRs
